group_note: All six were read as structure=plain and all six are plain_mcq on E1, so the grouping holds. Four of them (q109, q111, q112, q114) are the same demand — a stem naming a term or property with four same-kind options, one stored association deciding it — and therefore carry identical labels, recall + single_step, as rule 0.7 requires of equal demands. Two differ, and the difference is stated rather than left implicit: q110 is the only item whose options pair two linked verdicts, so the structural verdict (analogous, not homologous) has to be settled before the evolutionary one follows from it, which is why it alone carries concept_discrimination and multi_step_dependent; q113 is the only item that applies a known anatomical fact to a new case (a lesion) rather than looking an association up, which is why it alone carries application. elimination is carried by q110 alone, where the fixed coupling of analogy with convergence names the option it strikes; elsewhere all four options are same-kind chapter terms and no shortcut was demonstrable. On E5, two items end with an empty traps list on purpose (q111, q114): their distractors are other taught plants with no competing fact attached, and inventing a route for them would be the guess the rulebook forbids. Where devices do exist they are option-specific — look-alike bio- terms in q112, the wrong horn of the cord in q113, a real answer to the whale-and-bat version of the question in q110.
